prompt: I have some coin flip data: 7 heads out of 10 flips. I want to estimate the posterior distribution of the coin's bias using MCMC with a Beta(2,2) prior. Implement Metropolis-Hastings from scratch, show me the posterior, and compute the 95% credible interval for the bias.

assertions.description: Code explicitly implements Metropolis-Hastings accept/reject step
Code uses Beta(2,2) or equivalent prior
Code uses binomial likelihood for 7 heads out of 10
Response reports a 95% credible interval on the bias
Response mentions burn-in, acceptance rate, or convergence diagnostics
